body:
Common application questions were difficult to connect to complete Reflex examples. This PR adds eight connected documentation pages demonstrating Python data apps, custom AI interfaces, linked charts, and model/media workflows, with descriptive titles and links from the existing tutorials and component references.

## User-visible changes

- Add a capability overview, dashboard/internal-tool guide, AI applications guide, model/media guide, execution/performance guide, function-to-app quickstart, linked XY charts tutorial, and pandas data-app tutorial.
- Demonstrate XY scatter selection filtering a bar chart and table, including stable record IDs, empty selections, reset, bounded payloads, and session isolation.
- Restyle the function-to-app calculator with labelled full-width inputs, explicit units, responsive form/result panels, and an accessible payment summary.
- Add a live pandas dashboard with violet accents, responsive metric cards, separate chart/table panels, and complete filtered aggregates.
- Supply copyable standalone examples for CSV analysis/download, image processing/preview/download, WAV normalization/playback/download, and a document assistant with permission-filtered retrieval and checked source IDs. A local calculation and toy classifier provide smaller starting points.
- Explain state, browser/backend execution, short background-event locks, persistence, and deployment responsibilities. Link framework evaluation and migration planning to the existing marketing comparison hub.
- Lead the performance guide with the published Streamlit NBA dashboard and Dash component benchmarks, including measured values, workload scope, source links, and the rendering choices behind the gains. Remove NiceGUI from the new docs positioning.

## Implementation details and boundaries

The docs enable XY 0.0.7 and require Python 3.11+ for their runtime; a version-marked dependency keeps the broader framework workspace resolvable on Python 3.10. Repeated compiler/plugin page evaluation uses deep copies of pristine cached templates, preserving ComponentState identities without accumulating metadata or style mutations. Regression coverage reproduces the original tree-mutation issue.

Image/audio upload examples remain plain code blocks. The pandas tutorial embeds a styled sample-data dashboard with summary cards, an XY bar chart, filters, and a table; its upload controls are omitted from the docs preview. The docs server does not enable an upload endpoint. The document assistant uses server-selected demo identities, not production authentication; image/audio examples demonstrate processing, not trained-model quality, microphone capture, or video inference. No universal performance advantage or measured search-visibility improvement is claimed.

A related existing background-event ordering test now waits on an explicit startup signal. Delayed-start cases reproduced the old fixed-sleep failure without weakening the ordering assertions.

## Validation

- The 86 exact-copy tutorial tests include image, pandas, linked-chart, document-assistant, and audio behavior. Production docs and standalone examples were built and exercised in Chrome.
- Browser checks covered XY selection/reset and independent state, predictions, CSV filtering and saved downloads, image validation and downloaded output, document permission/no-match behavior with an offline provider, and exact WAV output/playback/invalid-upload cleanup.
- The docs upload endpoint returns 404. New HTML/Markdown routes, metadata, sitemap discovery, navigation, and responsive layouts were checked locally.
- Full state unit tests passed (226); background-task cases passed with real Redis under both locking modes. Type checks, formatting, and lock consistency passed.
- Before the benchmark prose update, head 86c25e15 had 124 successful remote checks and 2 skips. The benchmark update at 58cca551 passes changed-file pre-commit checks, a production docs build, all eight local delivery/metadata audits, and rendered browser inspection; The subsequent pandas visual update passes all 86 tutorial tests and changed-file pre-commit checks. Remote checks for the latest commit must be confirmed separately. Required human review remains outstanding.
- Local preview builds resolved newer frontend dependencies; generated frontend lock changes were excluded. They are not frozen-lock rendering comparisons.

## Editorial review and publication

The initial 12 guide/article drafts were passed in full through Profound's writing-style and keyword review, with bounded edits and preserved runnable code. [Full drafts](https://platform.tryprofound.com/doc/4f507ad0-91d6-55f6-b8b3-bbc8c18981b4) and [editorial decisions](https://platform.tryprofound.com/doc/b5610252-03d7-509d-bdbc-f33c8265dcfc) are available for review.

The latest benchmark additions were checked against the published comparison pages and underlying reports, and the complete revised performance guide and overview were saved to the full-drafts document. The complete pandas and function-to-app tutorials, including their revised UI code, were also synced to that document; no new automated editorial review is claimed for this UI revision.

Publish these docs before https://github.com/reflex-dev/blog/pull/86, whose articles link to six of the new destinations. The latest public check still returns 404 for all eight new guide URLs. After deployment, verify live content, canonicals, crawl controls, sitemap entries, and Markdown routes before evaluating indexing or AI-answer changes. Profound draft reviews and local benchmarks are not evidence of post-publication recognition.
title: docs: add application guides and linked XY chart tutorial
